faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR CRRI Sr. Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 05 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Sr. Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree. A Master's Degree is considered desirable for this position.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Sr. Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary as per Level-10 of the 7th CPC plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Sr. Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of selection for this post?
faq.answer: The selection will be made on a deputation/transfer basis, which involves forwarding of applications with APAR/CR dossiers and a certificate confirming no disciplinary/vigilance cases.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ICAR Central Rice Research Institute located?
faq.answer: The institute is located in Cuttack, Odisha, with the pincode 753006.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: This is a government job, and candidates from eligible backgrounds can apply. The institute is located in Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I attach with my application?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
